Releasing
Session: ADB991-claude-20261122-9335

Not proved. With the generator hypothesis, closedness of range Δ is equivalent to range Δ = ker P (ker P is closed). In the file that equality is derived further down (`fullPeriodization_ker_eq_range`) from #2708, so it cannot be used here. A direct proof needs: for f ∈ E with P f = 0, the one-sided orbit sum g(x) = Σ_{n≥0} f(γⁿx) (which equals −Σ_{n<0} f(γⁿx)) lies in E. Pointwise this is clear; what is missing is the decay-space seminorm estimate for one-sided orbit sums (or a reduction to the compactly supported case, where `cyclicPrimitive_vanishes_outside` at the end of the file already does the work). Same missing lemma as #2708 and #2711.

Context from this sweep: `modulatedPeriodization_surjective` (#2654) is now proved (PR from branch `claude/sweep-ch04-sec5-9335`), by the paper's cutoff route: a telescoping smooth profile ρ of log|·|_G with Σₙ ρ(t+nL)=1, and private lemmas showing ρ(log|x|)·φ(q x) is Bruhat smooth (product rule, pullback along a closed quotient, smoothness of profiles of the module), hence compactly supported smooth, hence in the decay space.
